messages.subject: Ashfield v Marwick - draft settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Following yesterday's mediation, I attach a first draft settlement agreement reflecting the in-principle deal. As drafted it shows £320,000 in two instalments with each side bearing its own costs - that was our opening position on paper. Per our discussion at the mediation the parties landed at £295,000 with a costs contribution; we'll send a redline to that effect tomorrow.

Tom

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Ashfield v Marwick - draft settlement agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Redline attached. It moves the Settlement Sum to £295,000 (£175,000 by 5 December and £120,000 by 16 January), and changes the costs clause so that Marwick pays Ashfield's costs of £28,500 by 5 December. Subject to your client signing off we can complete a Tomlin order on these terms.

Tom

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
